description: Classification of all 441 FWP checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 10 FWP guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement - tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance - tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.drainage-area-calculation: Contributing drainage area must be calculated from watershed delineation
additionalRequirementTypes.waterway-classification: Waterway must be classified (minor/intermediate/major) to determine applicable CWQZ width and setback requirements
additionalRequirementTypes.cef-type-verification: Critical Environmental Feature type must be identified to determine applicable buffer distance
additionalRequirementTypes.ehz-boundary-verification: Erosion Hazard Zone boundary must be verified through geotechnical analysis
additionalRequirementTypes.slope-verification: Slope gradient must be verified from topographic data
additionalRequirementTypes.waterfront-overlay-verification: Waterfront Overlay setback zones must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.uplands-zone-verification: Uplands zone boundary must be delineated to determine natural buffer area requirement
